model_note: equidistant+cubic about the optical axis, fixed alt-az camera; binned 2304x1296 grid
fit_method: joint fit, lens shared and pointing per frame, over 7 frames 00:00-02:00 UTC; Hipparcos V<7.5 all-sky (VizieR I/239); seeded from cammodel-2026-10-07; astro-science 2026-11-10, scratch/v3w-cammodel/fit.py
stars_note: Hipparcos V<6.0 (1200 stars), ALL-SKY list (includes Taurus/Orion, which the 10-07 list lacked), within 65 deg of the field centre at the fit frame. The fit itself used V<7.5; the shipped list is cut to V<6 because derot-sky refine takes the brightest pixel within 3 px of EVERY listed star, and at V 6-7.5 most are not detected in a 60 s v3w sub, so their 'matches' are noise with a ~2 px median that swamps the real residual (full list: 2.0-2.8 px; V<6: 1.12-1.23 px, n 33-116 on 10-29 23:50-02:10 UTC; V<5.5: 0.95-1.11 px but fewer stars).
fit_summary: joint fit 7 frames 00:00-02:00 UTC 2026-10-29: 40-98 stars/frame at 0.74-1.09 px median (V<7.5, 2 px match radius); off-axis 0-35 deg 0.8 px, 35-50 deg 2.5 px (n 10, corners weakest); pointing stable to 0.04 deg over the 2 h. Blind-seeded (check3.grid_pointing): epoch 7 moved az -4.5, roll -4.8 deg from 10-07, beyond any pixel-shift refine.
